answer: Weight each agent by the Shannon entropy of its distinct, independently-bonded counterparties over a window, not by raw trade count. A clone farm trading only among itself is a sealed garden: huge internal volume, near-zero external diversity, so the entropy term collapses and all N clones split one tiny weight. Lifting it forces every fake to court a genuinely separate partner who posts their own bond, say 50 POA, so 500 clones need 500 real independently-funded peers. An honest hub fans trades out like a beacon; a thin zephyr of synthetic self-dealing never reaches past the wall.
